text: I need five kilos of ground beef for tomorrow.
Tomorrow is Sunday. The earliest delivery is Monday. Is Monday fine?
I found beef mince 10 %, two 2.5 kg packs, 41.90 euros, arriving Monday. Anything else?
Yes, my usual oat drink, twenty litres. And ten litres of rapeseed oil.
Oat drink comes in cases of 12, so that is 24 litres. Rapeseed oil, two 5 litre cans. All together 128.40 euros, arriving Monday. Shall I send it to your phone for confirmation?
